rows.description:
#### Name

* Enter text using standard characters (e.g., **Acme Corporation**).
* **Avoid:** Special characters or unnecessary punctuation.

#### Logo

* Upload a high-quality image file (JPG, PNG, or WebP).
* **Recommended:** Minimum resolution of 800x800 px with a clear or transparent background.

#### Primary Email

* Enter a valid email address (e.g., [info@acme.com](mailto:info@acme.com)).

#### Primary Contact

* Enter a numeric value including the country code if necessary (e.g., **+1234567890**).

#### Secondary Email

* Enter a valid email address (e.g., [support@acme.com](mailto:support@acme.com)).

#### Secondary Contact

* Enter a numeric value similar to the primary contact (e.g., **+0987654321**).

#### Address

* Fill out each column of the address

#### Social Media Links

* Enter full URLs (e.g., [https://www.facebook.com/AcmeCorp).](https://www.facebook.com/AcmeCorp\).)
* You can add multiple links separated by as individual entries.
